cattolica-ucsc-international-scholarship.about:
Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, one of Europe's largest private universities, charges a flat €8,800 a year for English-taught bachelor's students whose family income is produced outside the EU. The UCSC International Scholarship lowers this to €5,900 a year for the whole degree.

You apply for it during the online admission application (for example to the three-year BA in International Relations and Global Affairs) and hear with your admission offer. It renews automatically for up to three years beyond normal study time and cannot be combined with EDUCatt need-based aid. Students from Georgia, Qatar and any non-EU country are eligible.
cattolica-ucsc-international-scholarship.eligibility: Applicants to Cattolica's English-taught bachelor's whose family income is produced in non-EU countries; any nationality.
how_to_apply: Apply online to the bachelor's programme (window 4 Nov 2026 – 17 Feb 2027).
Tick/request the UCSC International Scholarship in the application.
Receive the decision together with your admission offer.
Pay the reduced fee in five instalments.
cattolica-ucsc-international-scholarship.costs: Reduces annual tuition and fees from €8,800 to €5,900 (about 33% off).

ceu-doctoral-scholarship-2027.about:
Central European University in Vienna funds its doctoral students through the CEU Doctoral Scholarship, which covers the full cost of tuition and pays a stipend of €2,002 gross per month for a total of 48 months. Doctoral programmes span political science, public policy, international relations, history, philosophy, economics, legal studies, network science, mathematics and environmental sciences.

All candidates who apply by the financial-aid deadline are automatically considered. Note that PhD stipends are taxable in Austria and holders must register with SVS health insurance.
ceu-doctoral-scholarship-2027.eligibility: Applicants of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) with a master's degree applying to a CEU doctoral programme by the financial-aid deadline.
how_to_apply: Choose a CEU doctoral programme and contact potential supervisors
Prepare research proposal, CV, transcripts and references
Submit the CEU online application by the financial-aid deadline
Attend an interview if shortlisted
ceu-doctoral-scholarship-2027.costs: Full tuition + €2,002 gross/month for 48 months (taxable; SVS insurance contributions apply).

ceu-masters-doctoral-financial-aid-2027.about:
CEU, the graduate-focused university founded by George Soros and now based in Vienna, is a long-standing destination for students from Georgia, the Caucasus and the wider region in social sciences, humanities, public policy, law, economics and more.

Master's financial aid is purely merit-based: a Master's Tuition Award covering 50% up to 80% of tuition (full tuition only in exceptional cases) and a Master's Stipend Award of €300–750 per month. All doctoral applicants who apply by the financial aid deadline are automatically considered for the CEU Doctoral Scholarship: full tuition plus a stipend of €2,002 gross per month for 48 months. There is no separate aid form for most programmes.
highlights: Open to applicants from any country, including Georgia and the Gulf
ceu-masters-doctoral-financial-aid-2027.eligibility: Applicants from any country admitted to full-time CEU master's or doctoral programmes, selected on academic merit; English proficiency required.
how_to_apply: Pick a CEU master's or PhD programme and check its specific requirements.
Apply online by the round deadline (PhD: 15 Jan 2027; master's: 2 Feb 2027 for early aid consideration).
Upload transcripts, CV, statement, references and English test (TOEFL/IELTS) results.
Aid decisions arrive with admission decisions (April 2027).
ceu-masters-doctoral-financial-aid-2027.costs: Master's: tuition awards of 50–80% (exceptionally 100%) plus €300–750/month. PhD: tuition + €2,002 gross/month (taxable in Austria).

ceu-masters-financial-aid-2027.about:
Central European University (CEU), now based in Vienna, is an English-language graduate university known for political science, international relations, public policy, history, economics, legal studies and environmental policy. Its master's financial aid is awarded purely on academic merit and is open to candidates from any country.

Awards can include a Master's Tuition Award covering 50% up to 80% of tuition (full tuition only in exceptional cases) and a Master's Stipend Award of €300–750 per month. There is no separate form: indicate your interest in the 'Funding' section of the CEU application and submit by the financial-aid deadline.
ceu-masters-financial-aid-2027.eligibility: Applicants of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) to full-time CEU master's programmes who apply by the financial-aid deadline.
how_to_apply: Pick a full-time CEU master's programme
Complete the online CEU application and tick interest in funding
Submit all documents by the financial-aid deadline
Receive the aid decision with your admission offer

chinese-government-scholarship-georgia-i.about:
The Chinese Government Scholarship is offered to Georgia under the 2001 education cooperation agreement between the two ministries of education. Georgia's International Education Center (IEC) runs the national competition and nominates candidates to the China Scholarship Council, which places them at Chinese universities.

The programme covers bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees, general/senior visiting-scholar research stays and Chinese-language courses. Programmes are taught in English or Chinese depending on the university. Candidates must apply in two systems: the IEC portal (app.iec.gov.ge) and the CSC portal (campuschina.org).

It is one of the few fully funded routes to a complete undergraduate degree abroad for Georgian school leavers, and the IEC holds weekly consultations in Tbilisi during the application window.
highlights: Full tuition, campus housing, insurance and monthly stipend paid by the Chinese Government
Bachelor's, master's, PhD and language/research tracks
National nomination by Georgia's IEC: you compete only against other Georgian applicants
chinese-government-scholarship-georgia-i.eligibility: Citizens of Georgia (and holders of Georgian status-neutral ID/travel documents). Academic requirements and age limits follow the CSC rules for each degree level (e.g. under 25 for bachelor's, under 35 for master's, under 40 for PhD). English- or Chinese-taught programmes; language proof as required by the host university.
how_to_apply: Watch iec.gov.ge (Programmes → 2026-2027 / 2027-2028) for the call, usually published in November.
Register on app.iec.gov.ge and fill in the motivation letter (in Georgian), CV and referee form.
Complete the CSC online application at campuschina.org (agency number for Georgia given in the call) and print the foreign physical examination form.
Upload passport, diplomas/transcripts and any social-status documents before the deadline.
Shortlisted candidates may be interviewed by IEC; nominees then wait for CSC/university admission in summer.
chinese-government-scholarship-georgia-i.costs: Covered by the Chinese Government: tuition, university accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance and a monthly stipend (CNY 2,500 bachelor's / 3,000 master's / 3,500 PhD under current CSC rates). Airfare is normally not covered.

chinese-government-scholarship-type-a-20.about:
The Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) Bilateral Program, known as Type A, is the government-to-government route of China's flagship scholarship. Quotas are agreed with each partner country, and candidates are nominated by their home ministry of education or the Chinese embassy before being placed at a Chinese university.

It is a full scholarship: tuition waived, free campus accommodation or a housing subsidy, a monthly stipend (CNY 3,000 master's, CNY 3,500 PhD) and comprehensive medical insurance. Master's applicants must hold a bachelor's and be under 35; PhD applicants need a master's and must be under 40. Many programmes are taught in Chinese (with a preparatory language year), but English-taught options exist.

Applications are filed on the CSC Study in China portal (studyinchina.csc.edu.cn) and submitted to your dispatching authority, typically between early January and early March.
highlights: Government nomination route — less crowded than university route in some countries
chinese-government-scholarship-type-a-20.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; bachelor's holders under 35 for master's, master's holders under 40 for PhD; nominated by the dispatching authority of a country with a CSC agreement (Georgia has a quota via its Ministry of Education/Chinese Embassy; check for Qatar).
how_to_apply: Contact your Ministry of Education or the Chinese embassy for the 2027 Type A call
Choose up to three Chinese universities/programmes
Fill in the online form on studyinchina.csc.edu.cn with the agency number given by your dispatching authority
Submit printed documents (notarised degrees, transcripts, study plan, two references, physical exam form) to the dispatching authority
Await CSC placement results (usually summer)
chinese-government-scholarship-type-a-20.costs: Tuition waived, free campus accommodation (or subsidy), monthly stipend CNY 3,000 (master's) / CNY 3,500 (PhD), comprehensive medical insurance (CNY 800/year).

clark-university-presidential-scholarshi.about:
Clark University is a research university in Worcester, Massachusetts. Its Presidential Scholarship is awarded to 3-5 first-year students a year and covers full tuition, on-campus housing and meals for four years; recipients pay roughly US$12,000-15,000 a year for remaining fees and costs.

There is no separate application. The scholarship committee reviews admitted students based on their admission application, and finalists are invited to an interview. All admitted undergraduates, regardless of citizenship, are also automatically considered for Clark's other merit scholarships, and Clark offers need-aware need-based aid to international students.

Apply by 1 Nov 2026 (ED I/EA) or 15 Jan 2027 (ED II/RD). International aid applicants must complete the International Student Certification of Finances and Financial Assistance Application in the applicant portal.
highlights: Full tuition, housing and meals for four years
Open to students of any citizenship
Automatic consideration for other merit awards
clark-university-presidential-scholarshi.eligibility: First-year applicants of any citizenship. Selection is merit-based; finalists interview.
how_to_apply: Apply to Clark via Common App by 15 Jan 2027 (or EA/ED I by 1 Nov)
No separate scholarship application
If shortlisted, complete a finalist interview
For need-based aid, submit the International Student Certification of Finances and Financial Assistance form
clark-university-presidential-scholarshi.costs: Full tuition, on-campus housing and meals; students cover remaining fees and personal costs (~US$12,000-15,000/year).

colgate-international-aid-2027.about:
Colgate University in central New York is a highly ranked liberal arts university. Its aid for international students is need-based and meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students; admission is need-aware for international applicants.

International applicants must submit the CSS Profile with their application. Deadlines: ED I 1 Nov 2026; ED II and Regular Decision applications 15 Jan 2027, with the CSS Profile due 22 Jan.
colgate-international-aid-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-year students who request aid in their admission application (aid cannot be requested later).
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by 15 Jan 2027
Indicate that you are applying for aid
Submit the CSS Profile by 22 Jan 2027
Receive aid award with admission decision
colgate-international-aid-2027.costs: Grant-based aid covering full demonstrated need.

columbia-financial-aid-international-202.about:
Columbia University in New York City meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for international students admitted as first-years (or transfers) pursuing their first degree at Columbia College or Columbia Engineering. Families with lower incomes often pay nothing toward the cost of attendance.

International applicants are reviewed need-aware, and you must say on your admission application that you are seeking aid; otherwise you generally cannot apply later. Apply Early Decision (1 Nov) or Regular Decision (1 Jan 2027) and submit the CSS Profile and documents listed in your applicant portal.
highlights: Core Curriculum in the heart of New York City
columbia-financial-aid-international-202.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years or transfers for a first bachelor's degree. Must request aid in the admission application.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App or QuestBridge by 1 Jan 2027
Indicate that you are seeking financial aid
Submit the CSS Profile and financial documents by the aid deadline
Receive aid package with admission decision
columbia-financial-aid-international-202.costs: Grant-based aid covering demonstrated need up to the full cost of attendance.

constructor-university-academic-achievem.about:
Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is an international, English-taught residential university in Bremen, Germany, with students from over 100 countries. Bachelor's tuition for 2027/28 is €11,925 per semester.

All admitted students are considered for an academic achievement scholarship of up to €10,000 based on school GPA, announced with the admission decision; there is no extra form and no nationality restriction. A Tuition Deferral Program lets you postpone part of the remaining fees until you are employed after graduation.
highlights: Tuition deferral: repay only once you are earning
constructor-university-academic-achievem.eligibility: All bachelor's applicants admitted to Constructor University, any nationality (Georgia and Qatar included). Amount depends on school GPA.
how_to_apply: Apply online for a bachelor's programme (Early Action until 1 Feb 2027).
Submit transcripts, English test or waiver evidence.
Your scholarship amount is shown with your admission decision.
Optionally accept the Tuition Deferral offer for part of the remaining fees.
constructor-university-academic-achievem.costs: Scholarship up to €10,000; 2027/28 tuition €11,925 per semester plus fees up to €350 and a one-time enrolment fee (€940 non-EU).

cornell-financial-aid-international-2027.about:
Cornell University, the Ivy League university in Ithaca, New York, meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for every admitted international undergraduate who applied for aid. Packages combine Cornell grants, an annual work-study award and, depending on family income, reasonable student loans.

Admission is need-aware for international applicants, so your aid request is one factor in the decision. Apply Early Decision by 1 Nov 2026 or Regular Decision by 2 Jan 2027 and complete the CSS Profile (code 2098); Cornell may request extra documents via IDOC. International students generally do not get CSS fee waivers, and Cornell withholds 14% US tax on grant aid above tuition unless a tax treaty applies.
highlights: Ivy League education across 7 undergraduate colleges
cornell-financial-aid-international-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years (or transfers) who request aid in the application. Need-aware admission.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by 2 Jan 2027 (RD) or 1 Nov 2026 (ED)
Indicate you are applying for financial aid
Complete the 2027-28 CSS Profile (code 2098)
Upload IDOC documents if requested
cornell-financial-aid-international-2027.costs: Grants plus work-study and possible loans covering the full cost of attendance minus family contribution.

coventry-university-group-scholarship-20.about:
The Coventry University Group Scholarship gives £2,000 off tuition per full year of study to international (non-EU) students on full-time undergraduate and postgraduate degrees starting in 2026/27 or 2027/28 at Coventry University, Coventry University London, CU Coventry, CU London or CU Scarborough.

It applies automatically on enrolment; 100% online and NITE courses are excluded, as are EU Bursary holders. Students from Georgia, Qatar and all non-EU countries qualify.
highlights: Campuses in Coventry, London and Scarborough
coventry-university-group-scholarship-20.eligibility: Non-EU international students fully enrolled on a full-time degree starting 2026/27 or 2027/28 at a Coventry University Group institution (not online/NITE, not EU Bursary holders).
how_to_apply: Apply directly or via UCAS for a Coventry University Group degree.
Accept your offer and fully enrol.
The £2,000 is deducted from each full year's tuition.
coventry-university-group-scholarship-20.costs: £2,000 tuition fee reduction per full year of study.

cuhk-admission-scholarships-non-local-20.about:
The Chinese University of Hong Kong offers admission scholarships to non-local new undergraduates with excellent academic or non-academic records, with any qualification that meets entry requirements. Awards range from HK$5,000 to full tuition (HK$230,000 a year for 2027-28), many are renewable for the normal study period, and some include an allowance of up to HK$66,000 a year. CUHK also nominates first-years for the HKSAR Government Scholarship (HK$80,000/year for non-local students) and Belt and Road Scholarship, and gives one-off awards of HK$50,000-214,000 for excellence in sports, music, art or science.

There is no scholarship application: CUHK identifies recipients and sends offers with admission. Submit one online application by 12 Nov 2026 (Advance Offer round) or 7 Jan 2027 (Regular round); fee HK$500.
highlights: Up to full tuition plus HK$66,000/year allowance
cuhk-admission-scholarships-non-local-20.eligibility: Non-local students (any nationality) admitted to full-time undergraduate programmes with qualifications such as IB, A-Level, SAT/AP or national diplomas. Mainland Gaokao students apply via a separate scheme.
how_to_apply: Submit the CUHK online application (one application only) by 12 Nov 2026 or 7 Jan 2027
Upload transcripts, predicted grades, English test and references
Attend interview if invited
Scholarship offers come with the admission offer (Dec 2026-Jul 2027)
cuhk-admission-scholarships-non-local-20.costs: HK$5,000 to full tuition (HK$230,000/yr) plus up to HK$66,000/yr allowance for top awards.

cuhk-postgraduate-studentship-2027.about:
CUHK offers Postgraduate Studentships to qualified full-time research postgraduate students (MPhil and PhD). The annual studentship for 2026-27 is HK$229,200 (about US$29,400), payable throughout the normative period of study, and results are announced together with admission offers.

Strong candidates may additionally receive the CUHK Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship, and nationals of Belt and Road countries can be nominated for the HKSAR government's tuition scholarship. Apply through CUHK's online application system by your programme's deadline.
cuhk-postgraduate-studentship-2027.eligibility: Full-time MPhil/PhD applicants of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) admitted to CUHK research programmes.
how_to_apply: Choose a CUHK MPhil/PhD programme and contact supervisors
Apply online by the programme deadline
Studentship offered with admission if qualified
cuhk-postgraduate-studentship-2027.costs: HK$229,200 annual studentship (2026-27 rate). Tuition payable unless covered by other awards.

cuhk-vice-chancellors-phd-scholarship-20.about:
The CUHK Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship Scheme targets the most brilliant applicants to full-time PhD programmes at The Chinese University of Hong Kong. Recipients receive an award of HK$80,000 (HK$40,000 in year one and HK$20,000 in each of years two and three), an annual studentship of HK$229,200 (about US$29,400) for the normative study period, and a conference and research travel allowance totalling HK$30,000.

There is no separate application: candidates applying to a full-time PhD through the CUHK Online Application System by the specified deadline are considered automatically. Typical profiles include a GPA of 3.5/4.0 or higher, research awards or publications, strong references, or a PhD offer from a top-ranked university.
cuhk-vice-chancellors-phd-scholarship-20.eligibility: Applicants of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) to full-time CUHK PhD programmes with outstanding academic/research records (e.g. GPA ≥ 3.5/4.0).
how_to_apply: Choose a CUHK PhD programme and contact potential supervisors
Apply through the CUHK Online Application System by the programme deadline
Upload transcripts, research proposal, references and English scores
Scholarship decisions accompany admission offers
cuhk-vice-chancellors-phd-scholarship-20.costs: HK$229,200 annual studentship + HK$80,000 award + HK$30,000 travel allowance. Tuition payable by international students may be offset by other awards.

curtin-global-scholars-program-2027.about:
Curtin University in Perth runs the Global Scholars Program: you start your bachelor's degree at one of Curtin's global campuses (Malaysia, Dubai, Singapore or Mauritius), complete about one year (200 credits), and then transfer to Curtin Perth without reapplying. Every accepted student receives an A$15,000 scholarship credited to tuition.

It suits students who want an Australian degree at lower overall cost, since first-year fees and living costs at the global campuses are typically lower than in Perth. You must be new to Curtin; eligible courses vary by campus.
highlights: Start in Malaysia, Dubai, Singapore or Mauritius
curtin-global-scholars-program-2027.eligibility: New-to-Curtin international students starting an eligible bachelor's at a Curtin global campus.
how_to_apply: Choose an eligible course and starting campus
Apply to Curtin by the key date for your 2027 intake
Complete 200 credits, then transfer to Perth
curtin-global-scholars-program-2027.costs: A$15,000 credited toward tuition (Perth international tuition roughly A$35,000-45,000/year).

czech-bilateral-scholarship-georgia-iec-.about:
Under the 2017 education agreement between Georgia and the Czech Republic, the Czech Ministry of Education offers short and medium-length study stays to students of Georgian higher education institutions, plus research stays for lecturers and researchers. IEC collects and pre-selects applications.

This is not a full-degree scholarship: students stay enrolled at their Georgian university and spend up to one academic year in Czechia, so no entrance exams are needed. Many fields require Czech at B2, but English-taught courses are accepted where the host university agrees.

It is a low-competition alternative to Erasmus+ for students whose university has no exchange agreement with a Czech partner.
highlights: Monthly Czech government stipend and dormitory place on request
Open to bachelor's, master's and PhD students in all fields
No entrance exams: you remain enrolled at your Georgian university
czech-bilateral-scholarship-georgia-iec-.eligibility: Active students of Georgian higher education institutions (bachelor's, master's or PhD) who are citizens of Georgia. Czech B2 for many programmes, or English proof (TOEFL/IELTS/CPE) accepted by the host. Invitation/acceptance letter from the Czech host institution.
how_to_apply: Contact a Czech university and obtain an invitation/acceptance letter.
Prepare CV, motivation letter, diploma/transcript, one recommendation from your Georgian university (issued in the last 6 months), language certificate and passport copy.
PhD applicants add a research plan (max. 3 pages) and publication list.
E-mail the package to info-iec@iec.gov.ge during the February–March window.
czech-bilateral-scholarship-georgia-iec-.costs: Monthly stipend paid by the Czech Ministry of Education (researchers: CZK 933/day); host dormitory at student rates. Travel to and from Czechia is paid by the student.

davidson-international-aid-2027.about:
Davidson College near Charlotte, North Carolina, is a highly selective liberal arts college. International applicants can receive need-based aid, but must apply for it at the time of admission; requests after admission are not accepted. After you submit the Common App or Coalition application, a Financial Verification Form appears in your Davidson portal.

Davidson also offers merit scholarships: the John M. Belk Scholarship and Charles Scholarship by nomination, the William Holt Terry Scholarship by competition, and application-based awards in arts, music, writing and Latin. It also runs the Alvarez Scholars Program for international students.
highlights: Full-cost John M. Belk merit scholarship (nomination)
davidson-international-aid-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years; must request need-based aid in the admission application.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App or Coalition by the RD deadline (early January)
Request need-based aid in the application
Complete the Financial Verification Form in your Davidson portal
Ask your counselor about Belk/Charles nominations; apply for arts or writing scholarships if relevant
davidson-international-aid-2027.costs: Need-based grants toward cost of attendance; Belk Scholarship covers full cost.

dcu-international-merit-scholarship-non-.about:
DCU offers partial merit-based scholarships to non-EU students for 2027-28, applied as a reduction on the full-time non-EU tuition fee. Faculty awards include €5,000 for undergraduate programmes in the Faculty of Engineering and Computing (e.g. Common Entry Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science and AI) and €1,850 for Humanities and Social Sciences programmes (e.g. International Relations, Law, Languages, Jazz).

All non-EU applicants are automatically considered and are told with their admission decision. Only one DCU scholarship can be held. Students from Georgia, Qatar and any non-EU country qualify.
dcu-international-merit-scholarship-non-.eligibility: Non-EU applicants to eligible full-time DCU undergraduate programmes for 2027-28.
how_to_apply: Apply to DCU as a non-EU undergraduate (direct international application).
You are automatically considered for the faculty merit scholarship.
The award is communicated with your offer.
dcu-international-merit-scholarship-non-.costs: €5,000 (Engineering & Computing) or €1,850 (Humanities & Social Sciences) reduction on 2027-28 non-EU tuition; other faculties have their own awards.

denison-international-aid-merit-2027.about:
Denison University is a residential liberal arts college in Ohio. International students are eligible for the same need-based aid as US students, and Denison meets 100% of each admitted student's demonstrated need. Every applicant is also automatically considered for merit scholarships ranging from US$5,000 a year to full tuition, awarded at admission.

To apply for need-based aid, tick the aid box on the Common App and upload the free Denison Certification of Finances (available from 1 Oct) to your portal. Denison does not accept the CSS Profile from international applicants. Deadlines: ED 1 on 15 Nov, ED 2 and RD on 15 Jan.
highlights: Merit from US$5,000/year to full tuition
Free Certification of Finances, no CSS Profile
denison-international-aid-merit-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-year students who request aid in their admission application (aid cannot be requested later).
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App or Coalition by 15 Jan 2027 (RD)
Tick that you intend to apply for financial aid
Upload the Denison Certification of Finances in your portal
Merit and need awards arrive with admission
denison-international-aid-merit-2027.costs: Merit up to full tuition plus need-based grants up to full cost of attendance.

dickinson-international-merit-aid-2027.about:
Dickinson College in Pennsylvania is known for global studies, languages and study abroad. International students are eligible for merit scholarships (no separate application: your admission application is reviewed) and for limited need-based aid; merit and need awards are sent with the admission offer.

All international applicants submit the 2027-28 International Certification of Finances. Aid applicants also file the CSS Profile (or the ISFAA if they cannot) by the admission deadline. Health insurance (~US$2,500) and visa fees are not covered by need-based aid.
dickinson-international-merit-aid-2027.eligibility: International first-year applicants. Need-based aid is limited.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by the RD deadline (typically 15 Jan 2027)
Indicate intent to apply for aid
Submit the CSS Profile or ISFAA and the International Certification of Finances
Receive merit/need award with your offer
dickinson-international-merit-aid-2027.costs: Merit scholarships and need-based grants toward cost of attendance (~US$85,000).

dlut-chinese-government-scholarship-high.about:
Dalian University of Technology (DUT), one of China's leading engineering universities, selects international students directly for two Chinese Government Scholarship tracks set up by China's Ministry of Education: the High-Level Postgraduate Program and the Silk Road Program. Scholarships run for three years (master's) or four years (PhD).

Winners are exempt from tuition and receive free on-campus accommodation, a monthly allowance of CNY 3,000 (master's) or CNY 3,500 (PhD) and CSC comprehensive medical insurance. Master's applicants must be under 35 with a bachelor's; PhD applicants under 40 with a master's. Most programmes are in Chinese, some in English.

Apply between 1 November 2026 and 15 February 2027 on the CSC portal (Agency No. 10141) and DUT's own system.
highlights: Full CSC package via direct university selection
Silk Road track for Belt and Road countries
dlut-chinese-government-scholarship-high.eligibility: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; master's under 35 with a bachelor's, PhD under 40 with a master's; language requirements of the chosen programme. Open to all nationalities incl. Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Pick an English- or Chinese-taught programme at DUT
Optionally contact a supervisor for an acceptance letter
Apply on studyinchina.csc.edu.cn using Agency No. 10141 and on DUT's admission system
Submit before 15 February 2027
dlut-chinese-government-scholarship-high.costs: Tuition waived, free campus accommodation (or subsidy), monthly stipend CNY 3,000 (master's) / CNY 3,500 (PhD), comprehensive medical insurance (CNY 800/year).

dsu-toscana-scholarship-bachelor-2027.about:
DSU Toscana is the regional right-to-study agency for universities in Tuscany, including the University of Pisa, University of Florence and University of Siena. Its scholarship gives eligible students exemption from tuition fees, a free bed in a university residence or a rent subsidy for students living away from home, free meals in DSU canteens and a cash allowance for books and other expenses.

It is open to students from any country enrolling in a bachelor's, single-cycle or master's degree, provided they do not already hold a qualification at the same level and meet the income/asset limits. Non-EU students submit family income documents from their home country (Appendix B of the call). The amount depends on economic conditions and whether you are on-site, commuter or off-site.
highlights: Tuition exemption + free housing + free meals
Open to students from any country
Covers Pisa, Florence and Siena universities
dsu-toscana-scholarship-bachelor-2027.eligibility: Students of any nationality enrolling in or enrolled at a Tuscan university (bachelor's included) who meet economic requirements and do not already hold a degree at the same level.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to an English- or Italian-taught bachelor's at Pisa, Florence or Siena.
Gather family income/asset documents (translated and legalised) as listed in Appendix B of the call.
Submit the DSU application online through 'Sportello Studente' by the call's deadline (early September).
Check the ranking lists and accommodation assignments.
dsu-toscana-scholarship-bachelor-2027.costs: Tuition exemption, accommodation or rent subsidy, free meals and a cash allowance; amount varies by economic situation and student status.

dtu-msc-tuition-fee-waiver-2027.about:
DTU (Technical University of Denmark) offers a very limited number of tuition fee waivers to new international MSc students from outside the EU/EEA who apply for the autumn intake. A waiver covers the tuition fee for the full two years of the MSc and is awarded on excellent academic performance.

There is no separate form: apply for an MSc programme by the 15 January deadline and upload a separate personal statement clearly stating that you are applying for the tuition fee waiver. Waivers are not offered for the spring intake.
dtu-msc-tuition-fee-waiver-2027.eligibility: New non-EU/EEA MSc applicants (Georgian and Qatari nationals qualify) for the autumn 2027 intake with excellent academic records.
how_to_apply: Choose an English-taught MSc at DTU
Apply online by 15 January 2027
Add a personal statement stating you apply for the tuition fee waiver
Await the admission and waiver decision in spring
dtu-msc-tuition-fee-waiver-2027.costs: Full tuition for 2 years waived; living costs not covered.

dundee-global-excellence-scholarship-und.about:
The University of Dundee (Scotland) offers the Global Excellence Scholarship as a £3,000-per-year tuition discount for up to five years (maximum £15,000) to international fee-paying undergraduates starting in September 2027 or January 2028.

You need an offer for a full-time on-campus programme with fees of at least £19,450 (Medicine and Dentistry excluded) and AAB at A level or equivalent. There is no nationality restriction. Eligibility is assessed automatically at offer stage and shown in the eVision portal.
dundee-global-excellence-scholarship-und.eligibility: International fee payers with an offer for an eligible full-time on-campus undergraduate programme (fee ≥ £19,450; not Medicine/Dentistry) and AAB at A level or equivalent. Not International College Dundee applicants.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Meet AAB (or equivalent); pending results are verified before confirmation.
Check the eVision portal for the scholarship decision at offer stage.
dundee-global-excellence-scholarship-und.costs: £3,000 tuition fee discount per year for up to 5 years.

durham-inspiring-excellence-postgraduate.about:
Durham University's Inspiring Excellence Postgraduate Scholarship is a competitive partial award of £5,000 or £10,000 in tuition fee discounts for self-funded international applicants starting an eligible postgraduate programme in September 2027. It cannot be combined with other funding.

There are three application rounds (7 December 2026, 15 March 2027, 1 May 2027). Winners must meet offer conditions, pay the tuition deposit and enrol in September 2027.
durham-inspiring-excellence-postgraduate.eligibility: Self-funded international fee-status applicants (any nationality) with an offer for an eligible Durham postgraduate programme starting September 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible Durham postgraduate programme
Submit the scholarship application in one of the three rounds
Accept the conditional scholarship and pay the deposit by the stated deadline
durham-inspiring-excellence-postgraduate.costs: £5,000 or £10,000 tuition fee reduction for the first year. Living costs not covered.

ecole-polytechnique-bachelor-excellence-.about:
École Polytechnique (IP Paris), one of France's top engineering schools, runs a three-year, English-taught Bachelor of Science (maths, physics, computer science, economics, chemistry, biology double majors). Merit-based Excellence Scholarships of €4,800 per year for three years go to the very best applicants admitted with honours, who are told how to apply on admission.

Need-based aid for international students comes as a tuition fee waiver and/or an interest-free loan; merit and need aid can be combined. Any nationality can apply (Georgia and Qatar included). Applicants submit online, shortlisted candidates have a 50-minute video interview in English, and financial aid results come after admission results.
ecole-polytechnique-bachelor-excellence-.eligibility: Applicants of any nationality to the École Polytechnique Bachelor of Science; Excellence Scholarship only for students admitted with honours; need-based aid requires a financial aid application.
how_to_apply: Apply online via Polytechnique's application system (Round 2 deadline 6 Jan 2027; Round 3 8 Feb 2027).
Request need-based aid in your application if needed.
Shortlisted applicants do a remote interview in English.
If admitted with honours, follow the instructions to apply for the Excellence Scholarship.
ecole-polytechnique-bachelor-excellence-.costs: Excellence Scholarship €4,800 per year for 3 years; need-based tuition waiver and/or interest-free loan. All students pay the annual administration fee.

ecole-polytechnique-bachelor-olympiad-me.about:
For students who won a medal at an International Science Olympiad (e.g. maths, physics, chemistry, informatics, biology) in the two years before enrolment, École Polytechnique offers full scholarships for its three-year Bachelor of Science. Tuition is waived (except the €1,500 annual administration fee) and a living allowance is paid in 10 monthly instalments; the maximum is €87,900 per non-EU/EEA student and €78,750 per EU/EEA student.

Gold medalists have priority and an official certificate of the result is required. Renewal depends on academic success and conduct, and it cannot be combined with other Polytechnique or French government aid. Medalists from Georgia, Qatar and every country can apply.
highlights: Top French STEM school, taught in English
ecole-polytechnique-bachelor-olympiad-me.eligibility: Applicants admitted to the Bachelor of Science who won one or more medals at a listed International Olympiad in the two years before enrolment (priority to gold).
how_to_apply: Apply to the Bachelor of Science in Round 2 (by 6 Jan 2027) or Round 3 (by 8 Feb 2027).
Declare your Olympiad medal and upload the official certificate.
Complete the interview if shortlisted.
Receive the financial aid decision after admission results.
ecole-polytechnique-bachelor-olympiad-me.costs: Tuition waived (except €1,500 annual administration fee) plus monthly living allowance; total up to €87,900 (non-EU) over the programme.

edhec-international-bba-excellence-schol.about:
EDHEC, one of France's top business schools, offers a four-year International BBA taught in English on its Lille and Nice campuses, with Business Management (€15,900/year) and Global Business (€23,900/year) tracks. Excellence Scholarships cut up to 25% of total tuition for international students.

Candidates who apply in Round 1 or Round 2 of the international session are automatically considered (merit-based) and are told with their admission offer. Selection includes an online interview. Any non-French-baccalaureate international applicant, including from Georgia and Qatar, is eligible.
edhec-international-bba-excellence-schol.eligibility: International applicants (not holders of the French baccalauréat) applying to the EDHEC International BBA in Round 1 or 2 for the 2027 intake.
how_to_apply: Apply online to the EDHEC International BBA by 7 January 2027 (Round 2); €100 application fee.
Take the online interview (28 Jan – 9 Feb 2027).
Receive your admission decision and any scholarship on 18 Feb 2027.
Pay the €5,000 deposit within two weeks to enrol.
edhec-international-bba-excellence-schol.costs: Up to 25% discount on total tuition (tuition €15,900–€23,900 per year before scholarships).

erasmus-school-of-economics-philip-hans-.about:
Named after the school's emeritus dean, an eminent econometrician, the Philip Hans Franses Scholarship is a partial tuition fee waiver of €10,000 for the first year of selected bachelor's programmes at Erasmus School of Economics, one of Europe's leading economics schools.

It is for nationals of non-EEA countries (Georgia and Qatar included) selected for the International Bachelor in Econometrics and Operations Research, the International Bachelor Economics and Business Economics, or the double bachelor BSc² Econometrics and Economics. You must register and submit your admission documents in time, pass the maths entrance exam if required, and complete the immigration procedure.
erasmus-school-of-economics-philip-hans-.eligibility: Non-EEA nationals selected for an eligible ESE bachelor's (IBEOR, IBEB, BSc² Econometrics & Economics) for 2027-28 who meet all application deadlines.
how_to_apply: Register for the programme in Studielink.
Submit documents in the EUR Admission Portal before 1 Feb 2027 (15 Jan for IBEB).
Pass the mathematics entrance exam by 1 Apr 2027 if required.
Complete the immigration procedure (by May recommended; 10 July final).
erasmus-school-of-economics-philip-hans-.costs: €10,000 partial tuition fee waiver for year 1 (non-EEA tuition is higher; remainder payable).

erasmus-university-college-euc-scholarsh.about:
Erasmus University College (EUC) is the English-taught liberal arts and sciences honours college of Erasmus University Rotterdam, located in the city centre. Its own EUC Scholarship is meant for highly qualified students from any country who can prove they need financial aid to be able to study at EUC.

Non-EEA students can also combine it with the NL Scholarship and Erasmus University's other financial aid. Applicants from Georgia, Qatar and anywhere else are eligible.
erasmus-university-college-euc-scholarsh.eligibility: Highly qualified incoming EUC students of any nationality who can demonstrate financial need.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission to the EUC Liberal Arts and Sciences bachelor's.
Submit the EUC Scholarship application with evidence of financial need during the scholarship round.
Also check the NL Scholarship and EUR aid options for non-EEA students.
erasmus-university-college-euc-scholarsh.costs: Partial tuition support; amount depends on need.

ernst-mach-grant-fh-study-2027.about:
This Ernst Mach Grant lets undergraduate and graduate students from non-European countries study for four to ten months at an Austrian university of applied sciences (Fachhochschule), such as FH Technikum Wien, FH Joanneum or FH Campus Wien. It is a funded study period rather than a full degree, useful for master's students who want a semester of applied, industry-linked study in Austria.

OeAD pays a monthly grant and helps with insurance and housing. You need a nomination or acceptance from the Austrian FH, which usually works with partner universities; apply on grants.at by 1 February.
highlights: Funded semester or year in Austria
ernst-mach-grant-fh-study-2027.eligibility: Undergraduate or graduate students from non-European countries (e.g. Qatar and other Middle Eastern, Asian, African and American countries; check with OeAD whether Georgia counts as European) with acceptance by an Austrian FH.
how_to_apply: Contact the international office of an Austrian Fachhochschule (often via a partner university)
Obtain acceptance for a 4–10 month study period
Apply on grants.at by 1 February 2027
ernst-mach-grant-fh-study-2027.costs: Monthly OeAD grant plus insurance/housing support (rates on grants.at). Tuition usually waived for exchange-type stays.

ernst-mach-grant-worldwide-2027.about:
The Ernst Mach Grant Worldwide, administered by OeAD on behalf of Austria's Federal Ministry of Women, Science and Research, supports young researchers and university lecturers of all disciplines who are studying or researching outside Austria and want to carry out a research project in Austria. The target group is postgraduates (typically doctoral candidates) and postdocs from all countries.

Grants last one to nine months and are hosted by an Austrian university or research institution, which you must arrange yourself (an invitation/supervision confirmation is part of the application). The grant includes a monthly payment and OeAD support with insurance and housing; check grants.at for current rates. The annual closing date is 1 December for stays in the following academic year.
highlights: Austrian host supervisor of your choice
ernst-mach-grant-worldwide-2027.eligibility: Doctoral candidates/postgraduates and postdocs of any nationality (incl. Georgia and Qatar) studying or researching outside Austria, with a confirmed Austrian host.
how_to_apply: Agree a project and obtain a host confirmation from an Austrian university or institute
Prepare research plan, CV, degree certificates and recommendation letter(s)
Apply online via grants.at (OeAD) by 1 December 2026
Results in spring; stay during the 2027-28 academic year
ernst-mach-grant-worldwide-2027.costs: Monthly grant from OeAD plus support with insurance and accommodation (rates on grants.at).

essex-international-undergraduate-schola.about:
The University of Essex (Colchester campus) offers overseas fee payers from specified countries a £5,000 discount on first-year tuition for undergraduate entry in 2027-28, across all departments.

Eligible regions include every African Union member state, most of Asia and the Middle East (Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman, Jordan, Kazakhstan and many more) and the Americas. Eligibility is checked automatically from the country of domicile and fee status on your course application.
essex-international-undergraduate-schola.eligibility: Overseas fee payers domiciled in a listed country (incl. Georgia and Qatar) starting an Essex undergraduate degree in 2027-28.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Make sure your domicile and fee status are correct on your application.
The discount is applied automatically if you are eligible.

exeter-excellence-scholarship-pgt-2027.about:
To celebrate entering the QS global top 150, the University of Exeter is offering 150 Exeter Excellence Postgraduate Taught Scholarships worth £15,000 each to outstanding international students enrolling in 2027/28. The award is a reduction of international tuition fees for the first year of a master's.

Applications for September 2027 entry are open; once you receive an offer for an eligible programme, submit the scholarship application as early as possible.
exeter-excellence-scholarship-pgt-2027.eligibility: Outstanding international fee-paying offer holders (any nationality) for an eligible September 2027 master's at Exeter.
how_to_apply: Apply for an eligible master's at Exeter
After your offer, submit the Exeter Excellence application
Apply early; awards are competitive
exeter-excellence-scholarship-pgt-2027.costs: £15,000 tuition fee reduction for the first year. Living costs not covered.

fulbright-azerbaijan-foreign-student-202.about:
The Fulbright Foreign Student Program, funded by the U.S. Department of State and run locally by the U.S. Embassy, lets young professionals from Azerbaijan study for one year or longer at U.S. universities to earn a master's degree. The award covers tuition and fees, a monthly living stipend, health insurance and international airfare; the Institute of International Education (IIE) places finalists at U.S. universities.

Grants are available in many fields including STEM, agriculture, public policy and education; clinical fields such as medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and nursing are excluded (public health is allowed). Applicants must reside in Azerbaijan and have at least two years of professional experience and leadership potential.

Applications are filed on the IIE online portal (apply.iie.org). Selection involves a technical review, a reading panel, interviews and English testing. Grantees return home for two years after the programme (J-1 rule).
highlights: Tuition, stipend, insurance and flights covered
fulbright-azerbaijan-foreign-student-202.eligibility: Citizens and residents of Azerbaijan with a bachelor's degree, strong English and (per the 2027-28 call) at least two years of professional experience; U.S. citizens/permanent residents and dual nationals ineligible.
how_to_apply: Watch the U.S. Embassy page for the 2028-29 announcement
Prepare study objectives, personal statement, CV and 3 references
Submit on apply.iie.org before the deadline
Attend interview and English testing if shortlisted
fulbright-azerbaijan-foreign-student-202.costs: Fully funded: tuition and fees, monthly stipend, health insurance, international airfare.

fulbright-georgia-graduate-2028.about:
The Fulbright Graduate Student Program in Georgia is run by the Public Diplomacy Section of the U.S. Embassy in Tbilisi and funded by the U.S. Department of State, with co-sponsorship from Georgia's Ministry of Education, Science and Youth, Bank of Georgia and Georgia Capital. It provides full financial support for a master's degree at a U.S. university in almost any field, including business administration; the Institute of International Education (IIE) places finalists at suitable universities.

Applicants must be Georgian citizens (or neutral travel document holders from Abkhazia or South Ossetia) with a completed bachelor's and strong English. Selection includes document review, English/aptitude testing and an interview. Grantees travel on a J-1 visa and must return to Georgia for two years after the degree.

The 2027-28 round closed on 1 July 2026; the 2028-29 call normally opens around 1 April 2027. Use the months before to prepare essays and English tests.
highlights: Tuition, living stipend, insurance and flights covered
Co-funded by Georgian government and private partners
fulbright-georgia-graduate-2028.eligibility: Citizens of Georgia (or neutral travel document holders from Abkhazia/South Ossetia) with a completed undergraduate degree and English proficiency suitable for U.S. study. Two-year home-residency requirement after the grant.
how_to_apply: Watch the U.S. Embassy Tbilisi Fulbright page for the 2028-29 announcement (expected April 2027)
Prepare study objectives and personal statement essays, CV and 3 recommendations
Submit the online Fulbright application by the deadline (about 1 July)
Sit English/aptitude tests and the interview if shortlisted
IIE places finalists at U.S. universities
fulbright-georgia-graduate-2028.costs: Fully funded: tuition and fees, monthly living stipend, health coverage (ASPE), round-trip airfare and J-1 visa support.

fulbright-uzbekistan-foreign-student-202.about:
The Fulbright Foreign Student Program, funded by the U.S. Department of State and run locally by the U.S. Embassy, lets young professionals from Uzbekistan study for one year or longer at U.S. universities to earn a master's degree. The award covers tuition and fees, a monthly living stipend, health insurance and international airfare; the Institute of International Education (IIE) places finalists at U.S. universities.

The programme is open to all fields, with priority for areas matching U.S. and Uzbek government objectives. Applicants must be citizens of Uzbekistan residing in the country during selection, hold a bachelor's and have at least two years of work experience.

Applications are filed on the IIE online portal (apply.iie.org). Selection involves a technical review, a reading panel, interviews and English testing. Grantees return home for two years after the programme (J-1 rule).
highlights: Tuition, stipend, insurance and flights covered
fulbright-uzbekistan-foreign-student-202.eligibility: Citizens and residents of Uzbekistan with a bachelor's degree, strong English and (per the 2027-28 call) at least two years of professional experience; U.S. citizens/permanent residents and dual nationals ineligible.
how_to_apply: Watch the U.S. Embassy page for the 2028-29 announcement
Prepare study objectives, personal statement, CV and 3 references
Submit on apply.iie.org before the deadline
Attend interview and English testing if shortlisted
fulbright-uzbekistan-foreign-student-202.costs: Fully funded: tuition and fees, monthly stipend, health insurance, international airfare.

glasgow-global-leadership-scholarship-20.about:
The University of Glasgow offers around 350 Global Leadership Scholarships to international and EU fee-paying students starting a one-year, full-time, in-person taught master's in any discipline in September 2027. The award is a £10,000 tuition fee discount for one year.

You need grades equivalent to a UK first-class honours degree and an offer of a place. Decisions are made on a rolling basis within six weeks of your offer or scholarship application, so early applicants have the best chance; the scheme usually closes in late August. UofG scholarships cannot be combined with each other.
glasgow-global-leadership-scholarship-20.eligibility: International or EU fee status, grades equivalent to UK 1st Class Honours, and an offer for an eligible one-year full-time master's starting September 2027. Open to all nationalities incl. Georgia and Qatar.
how_to_apply: Apply for a one-year taught master's at Glasgow
Register interest and submit the scholarship application when it opens
Receive a decision within 6 weeks of your offer or application
glasgow-global-leadership-scholarship-20.costs: £10,000 tuition fee waiver for one year.

goi-ies-2027.about:
The Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES) are run by the Higher Education Authority to attract top international students to Irish higher education. Each year 60 scholars receive a €10,000 stipend and a full tuition-fee waiver from their host institution for one year of full-time study at master's/postgraduate diploma (NFQ level 9) or PhD (level 10) level.

Eligible hosts include the Irish universities and technological universities (Trinity, UCD, University of Galway, UCC, DCU, Maynooth, UL and others). For a one-year taught master's, the award effectively covers the whole degree; PhD students receive it for one year of their programme. Scholars also act as ambassadors for Irish education.

You need an offer (conditional or final) from an eligible Irish institution when you apply. The call normally opens in winter and closes in mid-March, with results in early June.
goi-ies-2027.eligibility: Applicants whose domicile of origin is outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and the UK (Georgian and Qatari students qualify), with an offer from an eligible Irish HEI for a level 9 or 10 programme. Russian and Belarusian nationals and previous GOI-IES holders are not eligible.
how_to_apply: Apply to a master's or PhD at an eligible Irish university and obtain an offer
Watch hea.ie for the 2027 call document
Submit the online application with CV, personal statement, academic transcripts and two references before the deadline
Results are announced in early June
goi-ies-2027.costs: €10,000 stipend for one year plus a full tuition-fee waiver from the host institution for that year.

great-scholarships-2027.about:
GREAT Scholarships are jointly funded by the UK government's GREAT Britain Campaign, the British Council and participating UK universities. Each award is worth at least £10,000 towards tuition for a one-year taught master's, and dozens of universities each offer awards to students from specific countries (recent lists have included Bangladesh, Ghana, India, Kenya, Pakistan, Egypt, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, Thailand, Türkiye, Vietnam and others).

You apply to the university, not the British Council, after receiving an offer. For 2027-28, for example, the University of Reading's GREAT awards for Bangladesh and Ghana close on 3 May 2027. Check the British Council Study UK site for the full 2027 country/university list as it is published.
highlights: Dozens of UK universities take part
Country-specific, less competition than global schemes
great-scholarships-2027.eligibility: Citizens of the countries included in the 2027-28 GREAT list (check yearly; Georgia and Qatar have not been on recent lists) holding an offer for an eligible one-year master's at a participating university.
how_to_apply: Check the 2027 participating countries and universities on the British Council Study UK site
Apply for an eligible one-year master's
Submit the university's GREAT scholarship form by its deadline (e.g. Reading 3 May 2027)

griffith-international-academic-merit-sc.about:
Griffith University, with campuses on the Gold Coast and in Brisbane, offers the International Academic Merit Scholarship: 20% of tuition fees for international students with high academic achievement who study full-time, starting in any trimester of 2027.

Griffith is known for hospitality and tourism, environmental science, criminology, health and the arts. Check the scholarship page for the academic thresholds and how to be assessed when you apply.
griffith-international-academic-merit-sc.eligibility: International students with strong academic results starting full-time study at Griffith in 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply to an eligible Griffith programme
Meet the academic merit threshold on the scholarship page
Accept the scholarship with your offer

grinnell-international-aid-merit-2027.about:
Grinnell College in Iowa is a top liberal arts college with a large endowment and about 20% international students. It meets the gap between the cost of attendance and the family's expected contribution using its own and other aid, and international applicants are eligible. Merit scholarships are awarded from the admission application with no separate form, and international students have no priority merit deadline.

Apply ED I (15 Nov 2026), ED II (5 Jan 2027) or Regular Decision (15 Jan 2027) and complete the 2027-28 CSS Profile (based on 2025 income). Grinnell has an open curriculum with only one required course.
highlights: Need-based aid meeting the gap for admitted students
grinnell-international-aid-merit-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years. Admission for international aid applicants is need-aware.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by 15 Jan 2027 (RD)
Indicate you are applying for aid
Submit the 2027-28 CSS Profile
Merit and need decisions arrive with admission (late March/early April)
grinnell-international-aid-merit-2027.costs: Need-based grants up to the full cost of attendance plus merit awards.

hamilton-college-international-aid-2027.about:
Hamilton College in upstate New York, known for writing, public policy and its open curriculum, promises to meet the full demonstrated need of its students for all four years, including international students who applied for aid and showed need at admission. Most awards combine a Hamilton College Scholarship (grant) with campus employment.

Hamilton is need-aware for non-US citizens. All international applicants submit the Certification of Finances in the applicant portal; aid applicants may also need the CSS Profile. Aid applications are not considered after admission decisions, and students who do not apply at admission cannot get aid later.
highlights: Full demonstrated need met for 4 years
hamilton-college-international-aid-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years who request aid at admission.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App (ED II 4 Jan 2027, or RD)
Request aid in your application
Submit the Certification of Finances and CSS Profile if required
Receive aid with admission decision
hamilton-college-international-aid-2027.costs: Hamilton College Scholarship and campus work covering full demonstrated need.

hkbu-admission-scholarship-overseas-appl.about:
Hong Kong Baptist University gives non-local, non-mainland applicants with international qualifications three levels of admission scholarship: Full Scholarship (100% tuition of HK$240,000 plus HK$52,500 living subsidy), Tuition-waiver Scholarship (100% tuition) and Half Scholarship. Awards are renewable for the normal study period with good results. Reference scores for full/half awards include A-Level AAA/AAB, IB 37/35 and SAT 1430/1360; quotas apply and review is holistic, including interviews.

No separate application is needed. HKBU also nominates students from Belt and Road countries for the government Belt and Road Scholarship and offers faculty-level awards. Apply in the early round for advance assessment (offers from late December 2026).
hkbu-admission-scholarship-overseas-appl.eligibility: Non-local applicants studying in Hong Kong on a student visa with international qualifications (IB, A-Level, SAT, national exams). Nationals of Afghanistan, Cuba and North Korea may not obtain visas.
how_to_apply: Apply online to HKBU with international qualifications (early round recommended)
Meet English requirements (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 79, tests from 1 Sept 2025)
Attend interview if invited
Scholarship offered with admission
hkbu-admission-scholarship-overseas-appl.costs: Full: HK$240,000 tuition + HK$52,500 living subsidy per year; Half: 50% of that.
